sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-1227 b"
sources.quote: TOI-1227 b is one of the youngest transiting exoplanets discovered, alongside K2-33b and HIP 67522 b.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around TOI-1227. Its orbit and size follow Mann et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
